name: isaac-sim
description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab for robot learning: install (uv, pip, binary, Docker, cloud), RTX GPU and driver requirements, headless runs and livestreaming, OpenUSD assets, URDF/MJCF import, ArticulationCfg and actuators, manager-based and direct envs, configclass, gymnasium task registration, training and playing with rsl_rl, rl_games, skrl or sb3, parallel envs, tiled cameras, contact sensors, ray casters, IMU, frame transformers, domain randomisation via events, teleoperation, Isaac Lab Mimic, the ROS 2 bridge, PhysX/Newton presets, solver tuning and exploding articulations. Use when the user mentions Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, Kit, isaacsim or isaaclab imports, omni.isaac modules, USD robots, URDF import, num_envs, Mimic, isaaclab train or play, ManagerBasedRLEnv, DirectRLEnv, PresetCfg, Newton or OvPhysX in Isaac Lab, or migrating from Isaac Gym or Isaac Lab 2.x.
